## Invitations

A total of 1459 people were invited to the outreach activity. Attendance was 117, representing a rate of 8.0 per cent. The attendance level indicates that only a small proportion of those invited took part. Participation tends to dip during winter and recover in spring, which may have affected the result for this reporting period. The figures should therefore be considered alongside seasonal patterns and any operational factors that may have influenced people’s ability to attend.

The invitation and attendance figures provide a basis for reviewing how effectively future outreach activity reaches the intended population. They may also help inform adjustments to engagement methods, scheduling, and follow-up arrangements.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS: the recorded total was 0. The number of people who received a reminder message was also 0. As no SMS or reminder activity was recorded, there was no follow-up contact through these channels before the event. Future activity may wish to review whether additional contact methods would support attendance.
